depiction.primary_object: open circle with S-curved arrow weaving between two X marks
depiction.composition: flat diagram of a tactical play or obstacle-avoiding route

readings.meaning: sports coaching play diagram (Xs and Os)
route, pathfinding, or detour around obstacles

ambiguity: Can be read either as an abstract business/life strategy icon or literally as a sports tactics board or navigation route.
task_intents: draft a strategy or game plan
draw up sports plays for coaching
map out a travel or running route
outline a product or career roadmap

Map out a scenic detour around the I-81 bridge closure
Sketch boss fight movement phase for Sunday's D&D session
Write down our bidding tactics before the house auction starts
Plot a flat 10-mile long-run route that avoids the downtown hills
Send the updated deck to leadership
Print laminated sheets for the assistant coaches
Check snow levels on the alternate pass
Outline a debt-payoff game plan that knocks out the high-interest Visa before November
Rework our cold-outreach strategy for mid-market accounts after the dismal Q2 reply rates
Plan the exact race-day pacing strategy for miles 18 to 26 of the marathon

Trazar ruta alternativa sin peajes hasta Valencia evitando las obras de la A-3

reasoning: The Xs-and-Os play diagram is the universal visual metaphor for strategy, tactics, game plans, and obstacle-avoiding routes. It fits high-level planning tasks in work, sports coaching, finance, and route planning, while staying very distinct from generic calendar or checklist icons.
